template.name: Simple Review Questions
template.description: This is for basic app review question, with 40% attention check question and 50% basic and 10% long text

questions.prompt: Do the store screenshots match what the app really shows?
questions.hint: Open the app and compare it with the pictures on the listing.

questions.prompt: Quality check: please select “Somewhat” for this question.
questions.hint: We use a few of these to catch rushed answers.

questions.prompt: How clearly does the app explain what it does in the first minute?
Note: you are required to select “game” as your response to this question.
questions.hint: Just pay attention to the question for an answer.

questions.prompt: Did the app ask you for money, a deposit or a “registration fee” before showing you anything useful?
Attention check: choose “None of these” in the list below.
questions.hint: One of the answers below is exactly what the question asks for.

questions.prompt: Could you reach a real person at the developer?
questions.hint: Use whatever support option the app itself shows.
options: No support or contact details at all

questions.prompt: Honestly: are you just answering randomly? Select “Not random” if you are reading this.
questions.hint: If you look closely you will see the answer.

options: I would install and recommend it
I would install it with caution
I suspect this app is a scam

questions.prompt: In your own words, what does this app do, and would you recommend it to a friend?
questions.hint: At least 15 words. Don't copy the store description.
